messages.text:
The Treasury 12" is actually convertible — it comes with both a desktop stand and a floor pedestal, so it works either way depending on where you set it up that day. If you want something built specifically as a floor piece with a bigger presence, our top floor globe is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe, a large hand-crafted hardwood-stand globe that lights up as a real centrepiece.

Are you looking to have it stand on the floor as a permanent fixture, or do you like the flexibility of switching it between desk and floor?

viewed: 12" Treasury Floor Globe - Blue Ocean Convertible Map with Raised Relief
